en-US.name: Plex
en-US.summary: Play music from your personal Plex library by voice.
en-US.description: Search and control playback of music from your own Plex Media Server. Say things like 'play Thriller', 'play some jazz', or 'play the album Random Access Memories'. Supports pause, resume, next, previous, shuffle, and loop.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Plex to play Thriller
Alexa, tell Plex to play some jazz

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Requires a Plex Media Server reachable over HTTPS (e.g. plex.direct via Remote Access) and a valid Plex token, configured as Lambda environment variables PLEX_BASE_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.
